# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

Be respectful and constructive. Keep discussions technical and assume good
intent. Every participant — maintainers, contributors, and reporters — is
expected to keep the project's purpose in mind: software that laboratories
trust with patient data.

## Expected behavior

- Critique code, not people.
- Keep discussions on-topic and technical.
- Accept feedback gracefully and give it kindly.

## Patient data is never acceptable input

This project processes clinical records. **Never paste real patient
information** — names, ages, phone numbers, report values, or images of real
reports — into issues, pull requests, discussions, or screenshots. Use
synthetic data. A report or PR containing live PHI will be redacted and may be
removed entirely.

## Reporting

Unacceptable behavior can be reported privately via
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/pixelnaitik/PathoMitra/security/advisories/new)
or through a contact on the
[repository page](https://github.com/pixelnaitik/PathoMitra).
Reports are reviewed within 7 days. Repeated or serious violations result in a
permanent ban from the project's spaces.

## Scope

This conduct applies to this repository (issues, pull requests, discussions)
and to any project space, online or offline, where a contributor is
representing the project.
